ux.text:
UX CONTEXT
TARGET: product
Technical SEO Services helps Enterprise Marketing Directors optimize their complex websites for improved search engine crawlability and ranking.

ONBOARDING
1. Connect your website account to start optimizing.
2. Upload your website's sitemap to begin analysis.
3. Set up your profile to track progress and results.

EMPTY STATE
1. No website data available yet. Please upload a sitemap or connect your website account.
2. Your optimization settings are incomplete. Please fill in the required fields.
3. You have no saved results. Start optimizing to see your progress.

ERROR
1. Website connection failed. Check your website's URL and try again.
2. Sitemap upload failed. Ensure your sitemap is valid and try uploading again.
3. Optimization settings invalid. Review your input values and try again.

TOAST
1. Website connected successfully!
2. Sitemap uploaded and analyzed!
3. Optimization settings saved!

BUTTON LABELS
1. Optimize Profile
2. Analyze Website
3. Save Results
4. Connect Account
5. Upload Sitemap
6. Set Up Settings
7. View Result
8. Start Optimizing
